name: Cursed Body
description: A creature that hits the creature with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of the creature for 1 minute. A creature can repeat this saving throw at the start of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
